servinfo.title: Blind Spot Monitor Control Module Self-Diagnosis Function

servinfosub.title: Description
servinfosub.ptxt: Blind spot monitor control module monitors conditions of the system components and circuits. When an abnormal condition in the system occurs, blind spot monitor control module performs control as follows.

servinfosub.title: Self-Diagnosis Function
servinfosub.ptxt: Blind spot monitor control module has self-diagnosis function that stores DTC for abnormalities detected in blind spot monitor system. Stored DTCs remain in memory of blind spot monitor control module (main) unless they are cleared.

servinfosub.title: Warning Function
servinfosub.ptxt: Blind spot monitor control module blinks blind spot monitor OFF indicator (1) and rear cross traffic alert OFF indicator (2) to warn the driver that a malfunction is detected or the system is disabled temporarily.

attention3.ptxt: Right after setting ignition “ON”, blind spot monitor control module turns on the blind spot monitor OFF indicator and rear cross traffic alert OFF indicator. If no abnormality is detected, these indicator lights are turned off in about 2 seconds after setting ignition “ON”. If any faulty condition is found, blind spot monitor control module blinks blind spot monitor OFF indicator and rear cross traffic alert OFF indicator.

servinfosub.title: Fail-Safe Control
servinfosub.ptxt: When any abnormality is found, blind spot monitor control module disables blind spot monitor control.
